results.title: Transportation Supervisor
results.description: About the Role We are looking for an experienced Transport Supervisor to oversee and coordinate daily transportation operations between the Distribution Center (DC) and assigned dark store locations across Kuwait . The role will be responsible for ensuring the timely and efficient movement of goods from the DC to dark stores, managing delivery routes and schedules, overseeing truck fleet operations and utilization , monitoring driver performance, and maintaining high standards of operational efficiency and service quality. The Transport Supervisor will also be responsible for route planning and optimization, delivery allocation, truck fleet management, vehicle utilization and availability, driver coordination, transportation performance tracking, and managing operational issues and delays . The role will work closely with DC and dark store teams to ensure smooth and reliable replenishment operations, minimize delivery delays, optimize transportation resources, and ensure that dark stores receive the required inventory on time. Key Responsibilities Manage daily transportation operations from the Distribution Center (DC) to assigned dark store locations , ensuring timely, safe, and efficient movement of goods and smooth execution of replenishment plans. Plan, coordinate, and optimize transport routes, delivery schedules, truck allocation, and delivery capacity based on business requirements, store demand, and operational priorities. Manage and monitor the truck fleet , including vehicle availability, utilization, deployment, maintenance coordination, and overall fleet efficiency. Coordinate and supervise drivers and transport teams , ensuring adherence to delivery schedules, assigned routes, operational procedures, safety requirements, and service standards. Monitor daily transportation performance and key KPIs, including on-time delivery, route efficiency, vehicle utilization, delivery turnaround time, transportation costs, and service quality . Track deliveries in real time, identify delays, route deviations, vehicle issues, and other transportation exceptions, and take timely corrective actions to minimize operational disruptions. Coordinate closely with DC, dark store, warehouse, operations, and other relevant teams to ensure accurate loading, dispatch, receiving, and timely replenishment of dark stores. Identify, investigate, and resolve transportation-related operational issues and delivery exceptions, conducting root-cause analysis and implementing corrective and preventive actions. Analyze transportation data and operational trends to identify opportunities for route optimization, fleet utilization, cost reduction, and process improvement . Ensure compliance with company transportation policies, fleet safety standards, vehicle requirements, driver procedures, and applicable local regulations . Oversee the training and development of drivers and transport team members, ensuring they have the required operational knowledge, safety awareness, and service standards. Prepare regular transportation performance reports and provide data-driven insights and recommendations to management on fleet performance, route efficiency, operational issues, and improvement opportunities. Support the development and continuous optimization of transportation processes, route planning, fleet management, and DC-to-dark-store delivery operations to improve efficiency, reliability, and overall service quality. Job Requirements Bachelor's degree or higher in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration , or a related field; alternatively, 3+ years of relevant experience in transport, logistics, or delivery operations . Proven experience in delivery, transport, logistics, fleet, preferably within a fast-paced e-commerce or delivery environment. Strong communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple teams. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret operational data and identify performance improvement opportunities. Strong execution and follow-up skills, with the ability to work effectively under pressure in a fast-paced environment. Good project management and process improvement capabilities. Fluent in English , with strong written and verbal communication skills. Willingness to be based in Kuwait and work according to operational requirements, including flexible working hours when necessary.

results.title: Divisional Operations Manager- Road Transport
results.description: 📢📢📢 We are looking for a Divisional Operations Manager- Road Transport (RT) Operations, based in Riyadh. JOB PURPOSE: To lead and oversee the overall RT operations across assigned locations, ensuring safe, efficient, reliable, and cost-effective operations through optimum fleet and manpower utilization, effective fleet availability and maintenance coordination, fuel and tyre cost control, strong safety culture, customer satisfaction, operational visibility, and continuous improvement, while achieving business objectives and agreed KPIs. To ensure that safety and environmental aspects of Sustainability are embedded into the business strategy and daily operations. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 1. Fleet Utilization & Availability Monitor fleet utilization on a daily basis and identify opportunities for improvement. Conduct daily fleet availability checks and coordinate with Maintenance to minimize vehicle downtime. Monitor fleet running kilometres on daily basis and control unnecessary or excess running. 2. Driver Management & Utilization Monitor driver availability and utilization on a daily basis. Plan and manage driver scheduling to ensure optimum utilization and minimize idle time. Ensure adequate driver availability to meet daily customer requirements. 3. Fuel Management & Cost Reduction Monitor fuel mileage/consumption and implement actions to improve mileage. Investigate abnormal fuel consumption and take corrective action. Control unnecessary vehicle running and identify opportunities for fuel cost reduction. 4. Tyre Management Monitor tyre utilization, replacement and performance. Implement effective controls to maximize tyre life and reduce tyre-related costs. Coordinate with Maintenance for timely inspection and corrective action. 5. Safety & Compliance Drive a strong safety culture across the driver and RT Operations teams with hearts and minds approach. Monitor driver safety performance and ensure compliance with company safety standards. Take proactive action to address unsafe practices and recurring safety concerns. Conduct enroute spot checks and reporting. Conduct pre-loading and vehicle & integrity checks. Incident reporting and participation in Incident investigation. 6. Customer Management Maintain close coordination with customers regarding daily orders and operational requirements. Ensure timely follow-up and resolution of customer requirements and operational issues. Maintain strong customer relationships and improve service satisfaction. Increase the revenues by increased truck utilization. 7. Maintenance Coordination Work closely with the Maintenance team to improve fleet availability and reliability. Support initiatives to reduce maintenance costs and improve preventive maintenance practices. Monitor recurring vehicle issues and ensure appropriate corrective actions are implemented. 8. Continuous Improvement Identify and implement new initiatives to improve operational efficiency, productivity and cost effectiveness. Establish appropriate KPIs and provide management with clear visibility of operational performance. Continuously review processes and identify opportunities for improvement. 9. Overall RT Operations Management Take overall responsibility for RT Operations at the assigned location. Preparation of daily, weekly and monthly reports and sharing with the stakeholders Participation in customer engagements and BPR Ensure daily operations are properly planned, controlled and executed. Monitor operational performance and take timely corrective action where required. Ensure alignment between Operations, Drivers, Maintenance, Customers and Management. Follow-up for Customer payments

results.title: Fleet, Maintenance & Yard Manager
results.description: Lead fleet, workshop maintenance and yard operations to keep the transport fleet safe, compliant and available. Convert operating plans into preventive and corrective maintenance, spare-parts, tyre, fuel and telematics control, and a safe, well-run yard. Govern uptime, cost, safety and asset lifecycle to protect service reliability and margin. Responsibilities Manage in-house workshop and external repair vendors: labor, parts, turnaround time and repair quality. Own spare-parts inventory, tyre management program and warranty claims. Track vehicle downtime, defect rates and repeat-failure root causes; drive corrective actions. Control fuel consumption, card issuance, reconciliation and anti-theft/leakage controls. Manage the GPS/telematics platform: driver behavior, idling, speed and route-compliance monitoring. Ensure compliance with traffic, transport and HSSE regulations; manage permits, inspections and incident reporting. Oversee yard layout, parking, staging, security and traffic flow for trucks and trailers. Coordinate yard safety controls, signage, lighting and housekeeping standards. Manage yard staff scheduling, gate-in/gate-out procedures and in-yard asset tracking. Own the fleet and maintenance operating budget; track cost per km/vehicle and variance to plan. Produce fleet KPI dashboards covering downtime, availability, maintenance cost and safety incidents. Qualifications & Competencies Bachelor’s degree in mechanical/automotive engineering, Logistics or a related field More than 5 years of experience Relevant experience in fleet, workshop or heavy-vehicle maintenance management Knowledge of preventive maintenance systems, fleet management software and telematics platforms Understanding of traffic, transport and HSSE regulatory requirements Vendor and contract management capability Budget planning and cost-control skills Strong problem-solving, root-cause analysis and hands-on leadership Effective communication with drivers, workshop teams and cross-functional stakeholders

results.title: Transportation Manager
results.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
results.description: Job Location: Desert Islands Resort & Spa by Anantara Anantara Hotels & Resorts is a global luxury hotel and resort brand rooted in Thai culture, with an intrinsic sense of authentic hospitality. Inspired by the Sanskrit word meaning ‘without end’, our spirit embodies freedom, movement, and harmony. We believe every journey should leave a lasting impression — for our guests and for our people. Founded in 2001 in Thailand, we have since expanded across the world, welcoming guests in some of the world’s most captivating locales — from pristine beaches and private islands to ancient sites and vibrant metropolises. If you are driven by a passion for generosity, warmth and heartfelt hospitality, Anantara offers a career without limits. We are looking for an experienced and responsible Transportation Manager to oversee the daily transportation operations for our team members and business requirements. The role will ensure safe, reliable, and efficient transportation services while maintaining high service standards and compliance with company policies. Key Responsibilities Transportation Operations Manage the day-to-day transportation operations and ensure smooth and timely services. Plan and coordinate transportation schedules based on operational requirements. Ensure all vehicles are clean, safe, well-maintained, and available as required. Monitor vehicle usage, routes, and transportation schedules. Coordinate transportation requirements for team members, guests, and business operations when required. Team & Driver Management Supervise and coordinate drivers and transportation team members. Prepare duty rosters and allocate drivers based on operational requirements. Monitor driver attendance, performance, conduct, and compliance with company policies. Provide guidance and support to drivers and address operational issues promptly. Safety & Compliance Ensure all vehicles and drivers comply with UAE traffic laws and company safety standards. Monitor vehicle registration, insurance, licences, permits, and other required documents. Ensure regular vehicle inspections and servicing are completed on time. Investigate and report accidents, incidents, and transportation-related concerns. Cost & Administration Monitor transportation costs, fuel usage, maintenance expenses, and other related costs. Assist with the preparation and monitoring of the transportation budget. Maintain accurate records of vehicle maintenance, fuel consumption, inspections, and driver documentation. Coordinate with Finance, P&C, Engineering, and other departments on transportation-related matters. Team Member Transportation Ensure reliable transportation for team members between accommodation and workplace. Monitor transportation feedback and take appropriate action to improve the service. Address transportation concerns and ensure issues are resolved in a timely manner. Qualification And Experience Minimum 3–5 years of experience in transportation or fleet management, preferably within the hospitality industry. Good knowledge of UAE traffic regulations and transportation requirements. Experience managing drivers, vehicle fleets, schedules, and transportation operations. Good knowledge of vehicle maintenance, safety, and operational standards. Strong organisational and time-management skills. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities. Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel. Ability to work flexible hours and manage transportation requirements in a fast-paced environment. Valid UAE driving licence will be an advantage. Not the right fit? Set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!

results.title: Logistics & Mobility Director
results.description: MARAFID is the execution arm of Riyadh Holding Company, specializing in the development and activation of economic infrastructure across three core sectors: Logistics & Mobility, Industrial Clusters, and Circular Economy. We bring together development, asset management, leasing, and strategic partnerships to translate these sectors into projects and services that support business activity and serve the needs of operators, tenants, and investors. Our focus spans logistics parks, truck stations, parking facilities, specialized industrial hubs, and infrastructure for material aggregation, reuse, and recycling. Digital solutions and shared services support the management of these assets and their connections with the businesses they serve. Through collaboration with public and private sector partners, MARAFID connects land, infrastructure, and operational expertise to support Riyadh’s economic growth. We are currently seeking a Logistics & Mobility Director to manage and coordinate MARAFID’s logistics and mobility ecosystem operations, overseeing sector assets, services, and ecosystem participants to ensure effective service delivery, operational performance, and sustainable growth of the sector. 1. Key Responsibilities Oversee logistics and mobility ecosystem operations, coordinating activities across MARAFID’s relevant assets, facilities, services, and sector initiatives. Manage the operational performance of sector assets and services, monitoring utilization, service levels, revenues, costs, and other key operational indicators. Coordinate with operators, tenants, service providers, and ecosystem partners to ensure effective integration and delivery of services across the logistics and mobility ecosystem. Identify and implement operational improvement opportunities to enhance asset utilization, service quality, efficiency, customer experience, and overall ecosystem performance. Support the launch and operationalization of new logistics and mobility offerings, ensuring the effective transition of new projects and services into ongoing operations. Monitor sector demand, customer needs, and operational trends to identify opportunities to enhance existing services and inform future ecosystem development. Coordinate with relevant corporate functions to support effective and compliant operations. 2. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field. 7+ years of relevant experience in logistics, mobility, operations, asset management, service delivery, or a related field. Strong understanding of operational performance, service delivery, asset utilization, and key operational indicators. Strong stakeholder management, coordination, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Fluency in Arabic and English.

results.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
results.description: We are partnering with a major Abu Dhabi based investment platform to appoint two Operational Excellence leaders into its Ports & Logistics platform. One role focuses on ports and maritime operations, the other on logistics, delivery and last mile. This is an operating partner style role, not a traditional strategy seat. You will work directly with portfolio company leadership teams to lift operational performance, challenge how the businesses runs, and turn improvement initiatives into measurable results. What you'll do Maintain clear visibility of operational performance across portfolio companies and spot where value is being lost Challenge and support opco management on productivity, asset utilization, service quality and cost Build KPI frameworks, benchmarking against leading global operators, and executive performance dashboards Lead and track improvement programmes through to measurable value realization Work alongside opco CEOs and operations leaders as a trusted, credible peer What you'll bring Typically 7 to 14 years of experience, with hands-on operational exposure in ports, terminals, logistics, express delivery, last mile or transport A track record of delivering quantified operational improvement, not just recommending it Strong grounding in Lean, Six Sigma or continuous improvement methods Industry operators, portfolio operations professionals, or consultants from operations and performance improvement practices with deep sector focus are all welcome The confidence and presence to engage chief executives and hold your ground on the numbers What's on offer A competitive tax free package with performance bonus, education allowance and full benefits, plus the chance to shape performance across some of the region's most significant transport and logistics assets. UAE Nationals are strongly encouraged to apply. All applications are treated in strict confidence.
